title: Redis
scope: A complete Redis path covering core and advanced data types, expiration, streams, JSON, Search, vector sets, probabilistic and time-series structures, transactions, functions, pipelining, Pub/Sub, persistence, memory/eviction, replication, Sentinel, Cluster, ACL/TLS security, application patterns, observability, performance, backup, upgrades, and production operations.
coverage_note: Redis 8.x data structures and modern Search/JSON/vector capabilities, plus replication, Sentinel, Cluster, persistence, and operations
